model.title: Let members renew a loan themselves
model.customer: You can now renew a loan from your account, at any hour, without calling us. If you cannot renew, the page tells you why.

questions.question: Who would not want this?
questions.answer: Desk staff at the small branches, who use renewal calls to check on older members.

questions.question: What does it cost if A-1 is wrong?
questions.answer: Calls fall less than we hope, and O-1 is not met.

questions.question: What would make us stop?
questions.answer: Fewer than 20 renewals online in the first month.

data.verdict_note: A person decides. MACH never recommends a verdict, and recording one creates no epic or slice and starts nothing.
